credentialPolicy: No provider credentials, tokens, endpoints, or account ids may be committed. Cloud adapters must read secrets from environment variables or a local-only secret store.
artifactPolicy: Every required production artifact must be downloaded or copied into the owning subject content repo generated-lectures folder, recorded in lecture-video.json, and verified with a SHA-256 checksum before publish.

providers.label: Approved Neural TTS
qualityRequirements: natural human-like classroom voice
sentence-level pacing and emphasis
active-recall pause silence preserved
binary audio response downloaded to local archive

providers.label: Local ComfyUI Generic Instructor TTS
qualityRequirements: natural human-like classroom voice
generic synthetic instructor voice only
no real-person voice cloning without explicit consent
sentence-level pacing and emphasis
active-recall pause silence preserved
binary audio response copied to local archive

providers.label: Local ComfyUI Instructor Motion Spike
qualityRequirements: subtle classroom head, gaze, posture, and pointer motion
pre-lip-sync motion only until a separate lip-sync stage passes
board readability and board close-up crop must be preserved
generated instructor disclosure must remain valid
operator motion review is required before publish promotion

qualityRequirements: audio-driven mouth movement from the final instructor audio

board readability and board close-up crop must be preserved
operator lip-sync review is required before publish promotion

routing.publishRequirement: natural neural audio must be rendered by local ComfyUI when available, copied to the subject repo generated-lectures folder, and recorded with a SHA-256 checksum; cloud-tts remains a fallback
visual outputs must be original or licensed, copied to the subject repo generated-lectures folder, and checksummed
avatar output must use the approved persona disclosure, avoid real-person cloning without consent, and be archived with a checksum
pre-lip-sync instructor motion must be rendered locally when promoted, preserve board readability, copy output to the subject repo archive, and record a SHA-256 checksum
audio-driven instructor lip sync must be rendered locally when promoted, preserve pause silence and face identity, copy output to the subject repo archive, and record a SHA-256 checksum
final video must be local, checksummed, captioned, and approved by the operator workflow
